content.tagline: Korean men’s grooming care brand Scott Hamish
content.descriptor: Cheon365: Seoul company behind Scott Hamish, a Korean men’s grooming brand with toner and lotion essences, cleansing foam, sun care, hand cream and lip balm
about: Cheon365 Co., Ltd. is a company based in Seocho-gu, Seoul, founded on 20 January 2020. It operates the Scott Hamish men’s grooming brand, manufactured by Korea Kolmar.

Scott Hamish built its concept around Scotland — tartan, thistle and clan crests — and launched in September 2020 with five products: toner and lotion essences, a cleansing foam, and a sun cream and stick. The range grew with hand cream and lip balm in 2021 and an all-in-one BB essence in 2024. In 2022 the brand was selected for a small-business support program and placed second in the Seoul Beauty Week pitch competition; in 2024 it entered Olive Young.
Scott Hamish sells through Naver, Coupang, Kakao, CJ OnStyle, Lotte Home Shopping and GS Shop, plus its own Scott Hamish Clan store in Seoul and pop-ups such as Doota in Dongdaemun.
